items.title: Lowe's (LOW) Ties Rewards And Home Services To An 8 Million Member Platform
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) has entered an exclusive partnership with Bilt, integrating Lowe's products and services into Bilt's 8 million member platform. The arrangement connects Lowe's merchandise, rewards, and home services with Bilt's neighborhood commerce ecosystem, including access through the Bilt mobile app. Bilt members are set to receive cross-program loyalty benefits that link Lowe's purchases with existing Bilt rewards and subscription offerings such as HomeCare+.
